_scope: st-bmyv.6 Biidaasige Park public art / Indigenous placekeeping / MT35 heritage source contract (current Fall2026 published route; individual installation may remain unverified)
_method: Bounded (<=10 min) source pass. Official Lassonde Art Trail interactive map + artist pages (Fall 2026 map image and A3 PDF, both dated Sep 2026), Waterfront Toronto July 24 2026 western-expansion release, and a City of Toronto Open Data Public Art GeoJSON check. Marker positions were extracted from published HTML/PDF text; lat/lon was NOT inferred from prose or from unverified georeferencing. No pixels inspected.
_ownership: NEW files only: docs/biidaasige-placekeeping-source.md and tools/fixtures/biidaasige-placekeeping-source.json. No meshes, shared files, bead closure, commits, GPU/browser, or other agents.

sources.note: 8580x5616 official interactive map base image, 'upside-down' (not north-up); marker fractions are relative to this image.
A3, 1 page, PDF CreationDate 2026-09-21; numbered art markers 1-14 (3a-3d) plus legend.
Names the western-section works and the fall 2026 Monkman/Al Qadiri arrivals; Indigenous design features; MT35 heritage elements.
City 2026 wayfinding map; text labels only 'Trajet (public art)' and 'The Drum'. Private local copy $WATERFRONT_RESEARCH/biidaasige/inventory/wayfinding-2026.pdf.
459 features; checked for any of the works and for any point in the park bbox. No match.

artTrail.note: The Fall 2026 map marks 17 sites: Ryan Gander's 'Stories of relics' accounts for four (3a-3d). All 17 markers are inside the park on the official trail map. 'First Sun' (Al Qadiri) page text is stale (says currently in NYC); the July 24 2026 release and Fall 2026 map document the intended fall2026 Toronto route; physical installation is not independently verified.

mt35Heritage.name: Marine Terminal 35 heritage elements (fragments)
unresolved: Waterfront Toronto says 'elements of the Marine Terminal 35 building' are incorporated, but publishes no fragment count, geometry, or point. The Atlas Crane itself is separately mapped at OSM node/9521067431 and already integrated in docs/biidaasige-heritage.md.

negatives: No GeoJSON/KML/KMZ endpoint was found on lassondearttrail.org (checked homepage and /art-trail/; the site is Next.js with a raster, non-georeferenced map image).

City of Toronto Open Data 'Public Art' GeoJSON (459 features) contains no Lassonde Art Trail / Biidaasige work; dataset years run to 2024. No work in the park bbox except three Distillery District pieces outside the park.
The City 2026 wayfinding map does not label any Indigenous placekeeping feature; only 'Trajet (public art)' and 'The Drum'.
No public source gives a lat/lon, footprint, or count for the Fire Holder, Sturgeon Stones, Marker Trees/Directional Compasses, Interpretive Signage, or MT35 fragments.
No source in this pass gives the exact geographic georeference of the official Art Trail map, so marker map-space positions are not converted to lat/lon.
privateImageIndexNote: Public reference image URLs are recorded per work and must not be committed. All Lassonde Art Trail photographs are rights-reserved. The official map image (8580x5616) and A3 Fall 2026 PDF are likewise private reference only; no pixels are copied into the repo.
